reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that adds a hover-expandable conversation table of contents with search, reading-position highlighting, and message navigation.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加可悬停展开的对话目录，支持消息搜索、当前位置高亮和点击跳转。
summaries.en: Adds a hover-expandable conversation table of contents to DSH Web GUI with message search, reading-position highlighting, and click-to-jump navigation.

capabilities: Displays a conversation table of contents in the chat interface
Tracks the current reading position while scrolling
Filters message summaries and jumps to selected messages
Adapts to interface language and light or dark theme
